unit_attributes.statement: This text is an invented visitor-center policy serving as a diagnostic source, not legal guidance.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to visitors before entering the center, except overnight staff.
unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must register before entering the center, except overnight staff to whom the registration duty does not apply.
Visitors are not required to wear a badge.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Inside the center, except for maintenance workers performing repairs.
unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must not carry metal tools inside the center, except maintenance workers performing repairs to whom this prohibition does not apply.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under this policy, concerning visitors carrying paper maps.
unit_attributes.statement: Visitors are permitted to carry paper maps under this policy, as this policy does not prohibit it.
Other building policies may possibly impose additional restrictions.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to overnight staff regarding the registration duty in paragraph a.
unit_attributes.statement: Overnight staff are exempt from the duty to register before entering the center.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to maintenance workers while performing repairs regarding the metal-tool prohibition in paragraph c.
unit_attributes.statement: Maintenance workers performing repairs are exempt from the prohibition against carrying metal tools inside the center.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to maintenance workers while performing repairs.
unit_attributes.statement: Maintenance workers may carry metal tools while performing repairs.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When the visitor desk is busy.
unit_attributes.statement: A delay may occur when the visitor desk is busy.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to staff regarding each visitor.
unit_attributes.statement: Staff should record the arrival time of each visitor.
